author: hypex
text:
GTA 6 STREAMERS ENCOUNTERS

Streamers can walk up to you with their phones out & start interviewing or annoying you. You can choose how to respond, including insulting them. During Kinda Funny's private Rockstar demo, Rob Nelson had Jason insult a streamer who approached him, making the streamer put his phone away & start a fight. Rob then knocked off the streamer's glasses, which Jason could pick up & wear

The streamer's live chat also appeared on-screen during the encounter

GTA 6 will reportedly have more than five strip clubs across its map, according to IGN.

But visiting them too often might actually cause problems for Jason and Lucia.

Jason and Lucia can hang out together or go off and do their own thing, and some of those choices can change how their relationship develops.
